---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Use case

Who is asking for this, and what problem are they trying to solve? Be
concrete — describe the workflow, not just the feature.

## Proposed behavior

What would the feature look like from a user's perspective? UI flow,
API surface, configuration, etc.

## Why now

Why does this matter, and why now? Is it blocking adoption, or is it a
nice-to-have?

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem (workarounds, existing features,
external tools).

## Scope

- [ ] Open-source core (would benefit all users)
- [ ] Experimental (can ship behind a feature flag)
- [ ] Likely Enterprise edition (see `docs/enterprise-edition.md`)

## Additional context

Links, screenshots, prior art from other tools, etc.
